pages.text:
So Long and Thanks for All the Fish was photographed at an aquarium in the gap right after I graduated, mostly with a slow shutter. [What the aquarium was to you at that moment.]

The work is sequenced in five chapters — yellow, green, red, blue, and finally black and white — each one carrying a different emotion. [Name the emotion each colour holds.]

The book is designed in the manner of an old astronomical observation archive. [Why the archive form.]

[Closing paragraph.]
